verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents S3-compatible AI Object Storage close to GPU compute, the LOTA transfer accelerator (now also on CPU-only clusters) with cache pre-warming for faster reads, and Cloud Console upload and download. It also supports API-token exchange for temporary storage credentials and multipart-upload lifecycle handling, which together cover efficient data movement in and out. Missing for 10: documented cross-cloud sync or migration tooling (e.g., bulk import from other clouds), ingress/egress throughput or cost details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
